observed_control_flow: Reads the first AIVariable's type code; the type-2 branch loads its string pointer from the variable payload at offset +8.
Passes that string to Kernel::GetClientFunction and receives a registered S3DX::AIFunction pointer.
Checks the registered function pointer and takes its callback field from offset +8.
Converts/copies subsequent input AIVariable values into a bounded local argument array, preserving supported value types through explicit type branches.
Caps the input array length at 33 total entries including the function-name argument, so the inspected path passes no more than 32 AIVariable inputs to the callback.
Calls the callback pointer with (input_count, input_array, output_array) using the ARM64 argument registers.
Uses the callback's integer return value as the output-value count and copies that many output AIVariable entries to the caller's output array.

callback_abi_corroboration.observed_legacy_callback_shape: int callback(int input_count, const S3DX::AIVariable* inputs, S3DX::AIVariable* outputs)
callback_abi_corroboration.observed_legacy_function_initializer: { name, callback, output-parameter names, input-parameter names, description, flags }

hud_action_separation.observed_role: queues named HUD action data and arguments
hud_action_separation.interpretation: system.callClientFunction is a distinct script API that can resolve a registered function by name; the queueing HUD API is not itself the native callback.
